descricao: Configuration header for Aruco markers. Pass this to 'OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.create_spatial_context' to create a spatial context that can detect Aruco markers.

metodos.desc:
Returns the components enabled by this configuration.
Note: Only valid after this configuration was used to create a spatial context.

propriedades.desc:
Dictionary to use to decode Aruco markers.
Note: Must be set before using this configuration to create a spatial context.
